subject: general
question: Simplify: x³ - 3x² + 9x – 12 - x³ - 7x² - 8x - 16
solution:
**Calculation:**

x³ -3x² + 9x -12 -x³ -7x² -8x - 16 

⇒ -3x² - 7x² + 9x - 8x -12 -16

⇒ -10x² + x - 28

**Hence, the required value is -10x² + x - 28 .**
